gc4_credit_stall@gc.todo: 2026-10-24 (pilot 1 problem 3; the coordinating session asked for a value that fills the 64-slot window): not settled by the cell env. The switch (gc_layer_int.diff gdakiCtrlRingSwOf, gdakiCtrlRdmaCollect) holds rank 2's RECV completions for <len> ms from <start> ms after the ring's origin (pilot 1: the CREDIT_STALL line 3 001 ms after rank 2's live line), so no credit goes back. Records go 5 per checkpoint per peer (pilot 1: 150 per peer in 600 steps at CKPT_STEPS 20, about 28 per s), and the senders stop with the stalled rank: every rank's steps stood still from about 60 ms after the stall's start to its end (step 375 -> 383 over 470 ms, ranks 0 and 2), because each checkpoint pauses the input until rank 2 takes its records. A longer stall therefore sends no more records (all 88 control summaries of pilot 1, the 12 000 ms SIGSTOP cells included, say sendq_max=0); filling 64 slots needs 65 records toward one receiver without its reply, which this workload never has. Options for the coordinating session: a library switch that sends filler records during CREDIT_STALL, or sendq_deferred reported only (a prediction change)
